shortDescription: Italy's Banco Desio MIL:BDB has agreed to buy an 85.3% majority stake in Cassa di Risparmio di Orvieto from Banca del Mezzogiorno for about €124 million ($136 million), the two lenders said in a joint press release on Thursday.($1 = 0.9124 euros)

children: has agreed to buy an 85.3% majority stake in Cassa di Risparmio di Orvieto from Banca del Mezzogiorno for about €124 million ($136 million), the two lenders said in a joint press release on Thursday.
The operation is in line with Banco Desio's industrial plan, which aims to strengthen its presence in central Italy
The deal is expected to close by June 30, 2027
The banks said that "utmost attention will be given to safeguarding employment levels"
